channel.title: The Daily Digest
channel.description: One top story from each of my chosen publications, updated daily.

item.title: NYT: COP31 Talks Collapse in Turkey in a Clash Over Fossil Fuels
item.description: European and vulnerable nations rejected a proposed agreement after Saudi Arabia and other oil producers blocked any mention of phasing out coal, oil and gas.

item.title: NPR: International climate talks end in disappointment
item.description: Some 200 countries gathered in Antalya, Turkey, for COP31, the annual climate negotiations. Countries failed to reach an agreement after conflict over fossil fuels - the primary driver of fossil fuels.

item.title: BBC News: Boss of British Gas owner Centrica 'hugely concerned' over impact of soaring energy bills
item.description: Chris O'Shea says the number of people unable or unwilling to pay their energy bills will increase when prices jump in the new year.

item.title: The Guardian: ‘I don’t blame any woman for being sucked in’: how the wellness industry is cynically exploiting menopause
item.description: Where women see hot flushes and brain fog, pharmaceutical companies see dollar signs. But are products like lion’s mane mushrooms or even magnets for knickers really helping them? Or is it all just a big capitalist con?…

item.title: Al Jazeera: Russian vessel hit by suspected sea drone at Libya’s Benghazi naval base
item.description: There was no immediate reaction from Russia, and no one has claimed responsibility for the suspected attack.

item.title: Ars Technica: GLP-1 drugs could have a surprisingly large environmental payoff
item.description: GLP-1 drugs could cut food demand enough to free farmland larger than Italy.

item.title: WIRED Backchannel: The Manosphere Isn’t Ready for Brothercore
item.description: Vulnerable, huggable, affirming, chiseled: Welcome to Hey Brother House, a content incubator for bros who just want to trauma-dump and play Mario Kart.

item.title: WIRED Science: Scientists Tried to Kill This Dirt, but It Wouldn’t Die
item.description: Biologically important chemical reactions persisted in the sterilized soil for six years—offering clues to how life on Earth may have gotten its start.

item.title: WIRED Business: Jensen Huang’s ‘Lying’ Alarmed Nvidia Board Ahead of His Resignation
item.description: Amid allegations of multiple affairs, including with a direct report and an alleged Chinese intelligence asset, sources tell WIRED the Nvidia board’s main issue was the former CEO’s “lack of candor.”

item.title: The New Yorker: Should the Democrats Impeach Pete Hegseth?
item.description: The new majority will face constant dilemmas over whether to hold Trump officials accountable or focus on delivering for voters.

item.description: INDIANAPOLIS — A man and a woman have died after a shooting on Indy's east side on Saturday night. According to the Indianapolis Metropolitan Police Department, officers were called to the 3600 block of North Grant Avenu…

item.title: Mirror Indy: Indy veterans face barriers to getting mental healthcare
item.description: One man said he gave up after being quoted a three-month wait for an appointment. The post Indy veterans face barriers to getting mental healthcare appeared first on Mirror Indy .
